response.sql: WITH cust AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), share AS (SELECT CustomerId, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM cust) AS share FROM cust), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM share), above AS (SELECT s.total, s.share FROM share s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_spent, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) AS avg_share_beat_by FROM above;
